newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fotex rallies on heavy buys by one broker.
newsitem.headline: Fotex rallies on heavy buys by one broker.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian retailer Fotex bucked the bourse's falling trend and rallied on heavy buying by one brokerage company, traders said.
"One brokerage is buying Fotex in heavy volumes," said Robert Forgo of MKB Securities. "This company have been buying the shares for days.
According to market talk, the purchases may be in connection with a recent conflict between two main Fotex shareholders.
A shareholder, Templeton Emerging Markets, said recently it was suing Fotex for violating minority shareholders' rights and failing to comply with Hungarian securities regulations.

Templeton said that Fotex founder and general manager Gabor Varszegi, through his Panama-based holding company Blackburn International, had tried to increase his control over Fotex with convertible bond issues that were not open to minority shareholders.
Fotex stood at 168 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange at 1100 GMT, up 16 forints.
